model: Model B - time-aware (history window -> future window)
label_definition: seller_high_risk_future: pct_late_future>0.15 OR avg_review_future<3.5 OR cancellation_rate_future>0.05, computed ONLY from orders on/after the cutoff date (PROXY target, not an observed ground-truth failure label)
feature_window: orders strictly BEFORE the cutoff date only
label_window: orders on/after the cutoff date only (no overlap with feature window)

comparison_vs_model_A_legacy.note: Model A is same-period/non-temporal (features and label share the same order history). Model B is genuinely forward-looking (features strictly precede the label window). Model B is preferred on METHODOLOGICAL grounds (real prediction of the future) regardless of which has the higher raw metric.
